description: This file defines the SearchBlock class for Drupal, implementing a configurable search form block with access control and form building logic.

classes.name: SearchBlock
classes.description: A Drupal plugin block providing a configurable search form with access control.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SearchBlock with form builder and search page repository dependencies.

methods.name: blockAccess
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to search content.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the search form, optionally for a specific page.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration for the block, including page_id.

methods.name: blockForm
methods.description: Builds the block configuration form for selecting a search page.

methods.name: blockSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the block configuration form.
